panel.title: Tables list
panel.sql:
SELECT concat(database, '.', table) AS table, sum(rows) AS rows,
  formatReadableSize(sum(data_compressed_bytes)) AS compressed,
  round(sum(data_uncompressed_bytes) / greatest(sum(data_compressed_bytes), 1), 1) AS ratio
FROM system.parts
WHERE active AND database NOT IN ('system', 'INFORMATION_SCHEMA', 'information_schema')
GROUP BY database, table ORDER BY sum(data_compressed_bytes) DESC LIMIT 10
